exp.desc:
- Supported growth from 18 to 65 staff
- Two office moves, supplier management
- Onboarding, events up to 80 people

cl.p1: when I joined my current employer there were 18 of us on one floor. There are now 65 across two sites, and I ran both moves, set up the kitchen, negotiated the cleaning contract and built a welcome pack that every new starter finds on their desk on day one.
cl.p2: I have eleven years in office administration and executive support. Coding invoices, booking travel, planning a Christmas party for 80 and keeping the directors free to do their jobs are part of my normal week. I would like to join a company that, like yours, is growing and needs someone to build structure.

letters.label: Assistant who grew with the company

cl.p1: four years on reception in a co-working building have given me far more than my job description: room bookings, maintenance contracts, supplies, and the ticket system for tenants. I would now like to run an office myself.
cl.p2: A firm of ten solicitors is the right size for me. I am discreet and calm when three things go wrong at once. I have not managed a deadline diary yet, and I am keen to learn.
